notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/161b9118fabc97407c33c522747ff14217cf35f8.png[/img]

Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7a
[h2]Welcome to the June track! There's more than one route to victory on this month's track.[/h2]

This is also our first Linux release! Please report any bugs promptly on the [url=https://forum.longplay.games/c/game-feedback/11]forum.[/url]
Please consider this Linux release to be a bit of a "beta" stage, while we continue to work out known issues with [b]AMD[/b] cards.
We are working to resolve these, but we have spent quite a lot of time trying to track them down, and we felt it best to get this game in your hands sooner rather than later.

Enjoy the track!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/ce9ee518f691b08601ade99c4abbed89a7d900f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Patches and prep for June tourney
notes.content:
[h2]It's time for the June tourney![/h2]
This build includes patches, prep, and updates to get everything ready for the competition.
Minor fixes added, framerate adjusted for 144hz screens and hopefully smoother streaming.

notes.title: Update notes for 0.9.0.4b
notes.content:
This patch brings in a small fix for a track glitch found by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiana_crohns_]Indiana Crohns[/url] (Thank you!) and a volume adjustment change requested by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/indiegameiacs]Indiegameiacs[/url], and an overdue track tag for [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hammersmithh]Hammersmithh[/url].
Everything is now ready for the April Tourney!
